sources.title: [2608.12158] Context Blindness in DPO: Mitigating Object Hallucination ...
sources.snippet: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress, yet they still exhibit object hallucination, generating plausible but incorrect descriptions that are inconsistent with the visual input.
